items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I worked there with everybody. With Billy Daniels.

ctx.x: Can you remember the whole band?

I can't think of the whole band. I've been in so many bands in my -- these were just outstanding men. I remember we had a piano player by the name of Ken Corsey, who also doubled on trumpet. I think he did quite a bit of work for Norman Granz at one time, also. But I worked there with him for awhile, and then Roy formed Stables another small band and we went to work in Kelly's Tables, and I worked there with everybody. With Billy Daniels. He was the darling of the lady's man -- oh, what a singer. He could just…
